name: book-fullstack
description: Book Learning Platform - Backend (Laravel) + Frontend (Vite + Tailwind)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "cd Backend && php artisan serve --host=127.0.0.1 --port=8000" "cd Frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.start: cd Frontend && npm run build && cd ../Backend && php artisan serve --host=127.0.0.1 --port=8000
scripts.install-all: cd Backend && composer install --ignore-platform-reqs && cd ../Frontend && npm install
scripts.setup: npm run install-all && npm run migrate && npm run seed && npm run build
